Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Raid Buff Off (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Cancel selected buffs during combat in selected areas.
Description: Global client. Cancel selected, manually cancellable raid buffs only in checked Ultimate raids during combat. Job-grouped buff checkboxes include AST's The Balance and The Spear. Seven Ultimate areas only. DTR raidbuff: left-click ON/OFF, right-click settings. Open /rbo. Defaults OFF with empty selections.
Changelog: 0.1.1.0: Rename DTR text to raidbuff. Restrict areas to the seven Ultimates. Remove the all-buff selector and group the screenshot-based raid-buff list by job, including AST's The Balance and The Spear. Keep only beneficial statuses marked CanStatusOff by the game. Prune obsolete buff and area selections on upgrade.
